content: Everything can be taken from a man but one thing: the last of the human freedoms - to choose one's attitude in any given set of circumstances.
author: Viktor Frankl
story:
Even in the darkest conditions of human cruelty and confinement, there is one inviolable sanctuary that no outside force can touch: the inner freedom to decide who you will be in response to what is happening. Viktor Frankl discovered in the concentration camps that while captors could control his body and dictate his physical fate, they could never command his inner attitude.

Between stimulus and response, there is a space. In that space lies your entire human freedom, your dignity, and your growth.
reflectionPrompt: What difficult circumstance feels restrictive right now, and what internal attitude can you choose that no outside circumstance can take from you?
